nodes.label:
Notice a Student
Moment
nodes.title: Notice a Student Moment
nodes.info: A mentor observes something happen -- a student is stuck, a student just succeeded at something small, or a student has finished a whole track.

nodes.label:
What Kind
of Moment?
nodes.title: What Kind of Moment?
nodes.info: The right response depends on whether the student is struggling, has a small in-session win, or has reached a large term-scale milestone.

nodes.label:
Apply Growth
Mindset Coaching
nodes.title: Apply Growth Mindset Coaching
nodes.info: Respond with 'not yet' language, and point back to a skill the student has already mastered to prove ability can grow.

nodes.label:
Celebrate Immediately,
One-on-One
nodes.title: Celebrate Immediately, One-on-One
nodes.info: Name the specific thing that just went right, out loud, within seconds -- do not wait for the end of the session.

nodes.label:
Save for a Public
Recognition Event
nodes.title: Save for a Public Recognition Event
nodes.info: A track completion or major project is significant enough to recognise in front of the whole club and families, not just privately.

nodes.label:
Student Feels
Progress Is Real
nodes.title: Student Feels Progress Is Real
nodes.info: Every path ends the same way: the student leaves believing their effort produced a real, specific result -- whether that recognition happened in ten seconds or at a term-end event.
